name: Product notices
instruction: Extract the data of this product notice.

items.text:
AQUAHEAT Electric Kettle, model AH-220
Thank you for choosing AQUAHEAT.
Capacity: 1.7 litres. Power: 2.2 kW.
The kettle switches off automatically when the water boils.
WARNING: Never immerse the kettle or its base in water.
WARNING: Do not open the lid while the water is boiling.
Descale the kettle once a month.
This product is covered by a 2 year warranty from the date of purchase.
Keep this leaflet for future reference.

TORQUEPRO Cordless Drill, model TP-18X
Battery: 18 V lithium-ion, charged in about 1 hour.
Motor power: 750 W. Two speeds: 0-400 and 0-1500 rpm.
WARNING: Wear safety glasses when drilling.
WARNING: Remove the battery before changing the drill bit.
TORQUEPRO guarantees this tool against manufacturing defects for 24 months.
Not a toy. Keep out of reach of children.

ZOOMY Battery-powered Toy Car, model RC-5
A fast little car for hours of fun.
Requires 3 AA batteries (not included).
WARNING: Not suitable for children under 3 years. Small parts.
WARNING: Do not mix old and new batteries.
Remove the batteries if the toy is not used for a long time.

LUMIA Desk Lamp, model DL-40
LUMIA - bringing light to your home since 1987.
Adjustable arm, three brightness levels.
Uses one E14 bulb (not included), maximum 40 W.
WARNING: Let the lamp cool down before moving it.
WARNING: Do not cover the lamp while it is on.
Clean with a dry cloth only.

BREEZY Hair Dryer, model HD-2000
Three heat settings and a cool-shot button.
Power: 1800-2000 W depending on the heat setting.
WARNING: Do not use near water, in a bathroom or near a bathtub.
WARNING: Do not block the air inlet or outlet.
WARNING: Unplug after use.
WARNING: Stop using the dryer if the cable is damaged.
Warranty: 3 years.
